regime.label: Short-gamma squeeze continues - spot cleared the 1080 wall, now stalking a fresh 1100 wall with GEX still net-negative below the flip
evidence: Cumulative net GEX stays negative from the 910 floor through 1110 and only turns positive at 1120 - spot at 1082.4 sits 37.6 points inside short-gamma territory below that flip, one strike further out than yesterday's 1110 flip.

Spot cleared the prior 1080 call wall overnight (+9.4 pts, 1073.0 to 1082.4) exactly as the squeeze thesis implied, and OI immediately reformed a fresh near-money call wall at 1100 (1,301 contracts) - resistance rolled up, not away.

The old 1080 strike still carries the largest OI at any single strike (1,901 contracts, +60 overnight) even after being breached, so dealers there are now delta-hedging an in-the-money strike - a live source of continued upside chasing if price holds above it.

ATM IV compressed to a fresh 3-week low of 13.48% (from 13.77%, -2.1% relative) even as spot made a new 3-week high - vol crush into strength, the same low-vol grind signature as the past 5 sessions, not yet a fear-driven acceleration.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 future closed at 1082.4 (+9.4 pts, +0.88%), clearing the prior 1080 call wall and printing a fresh 3-week high while ATM IV compressed to 13.48% - the lowest print in the visible history. Cumulative net GEX stays negative up to a newly-formed 1120 flip (from 1110 yesterday), so dealers remain short gamma directly under spot even as a fresh near-money call wall reformed at 1100 (1,301 contracts). Put OI at the deep 910 strike jumped 21.9% overnight (5,848 to 7,128 contracts) on 1,331 lots of volume, pushing pc_oi_ratio to 1.69 and pc_vol_ratio to 2.92 - both fresh highs in the window. Max pain held at 1060, now 22.4 pts below spot, a widening gap worth tracking for max-pain-failure risk.
what_changed: Spot +9.4 pts (1073.0 to 1082.4, +0.88%), clearing the 1080 call wall that had held unchanged for 5 sessions - the squeeze thesis from 07-15 played out overnight.

Near-money call wall migrated 1080 to 1100 (1,301 contracts) as OI reformed one strike-band further out; the old 1080 strike still carries the chain's largest single-strike OI (1,901, +60) even after being breached.
Gamma flip moved 1110 to 1120 (cumulative GEX crossing), keeping dealers short gamma directly under the new spot level rather than resolving the squeeze.

pc_vol_ratio more than doubled today (1.45 to 2.92) on a 21.9% overnight OI jump at the deep 910 put (5,848 to 7,128, 1,331 lots) - the largest single-strike OI build in the 3-week window, even as price rallied.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over 5 sessions (07-10 to 07-16) the S50U26 future rallied 27.3 pts (1055.1 to 1082.4, +2.6%) while ATM IV compressed 1.38pt (14.86% to 13.48%, -9.3% relative), extending the low-vol grind-up first flagged on 07-15. The near-money call wall rolled twice in the window - static at 1080 through 07-14/07-15 before spot broke it and a fresh wall reformed at 1100 (1,301 contracts) - while cumulative GEX stayed negative under spot throughout, with the flip migrating from roughly 1100 (07-10) to 1120 today as the short-gamma zone moved up with price. Max pain drifted up only 20 pts (1040 to 1060), lagging the 27.3pt spot rally and stretching the spot-to-pain gap from 15.1 to 22.4 pts - wide enough to flag max-pain-failure risk if it keeps stretching. pc_oi_ratio climbed 27.5% relative (1.322 to 1.686) over the window, the fastest 5-day acceleration in the visible history, concentrated in deep OTM put building (910 put OI +57.1%, 4,536 to 7,128) rather than near-money strikes - protective accumulation running alongside the rally, not a bearish repositioning. Net GEX stayed negative under spot for all 5 sessions, meaning dealers have been chasing the move throughout - consistent with Squeeze, not Pinning, despite 75 days still to expiry.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1100C / 1120C
strategies.rationale: Cumulative GEX stays negative up to the fresh 1120 flip, so a sustained push through the new 1100 wall (1,301 OI, reformed overnight after the 1080 wall was breached) would force dealers there to buy into the move, same mechanism that carried spot through 1080; compressed IV (13.48%, 3-week low) makes the premium comparatively cheap to own.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, approx 8.0 pts (1100C last 16.8 minus 1120C last 8.8); wing width 20 pts, max gain approx 12 pts.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close back below 1070 (yesterday's near-money put zone) signals the breakout stalled.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050P / 1000P
strategies.rationale: pc_oi_ratio is up 27.5% relative over 5 sessions and the deep 910 put built 21.9% overnight (1,331 lots) - live protective demand running alongside the rally; a small, capped-risk hedge below the 1050 near-put wall offsets a reversal without fighting the squeeze thesis directly.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, approx 7.5 pts (1050P last 14.5 minus 1000P last 7.0); wing width 50 pts, max gain approx 42.5 pts.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained close above 1100 without further pc_oi_ratio build suggests the put OI was precautionary rolling, not directional - reassess the hedge.

S50U26.prediction: Bias: continuation squeeze toward the fresh 1100 near-call-wall remains the base case while dealers stay short gamma under spot (flip at 1120) and ATM IV holds at a 3-week-low 13.48% - a 1-sigma daily move of 9.19 pts puts a single-session test of 1100 within range. This view is invalidated by a close back below 1070 (last session's near-money zone), which would signal the breakout stalled and hand the tape back to the still-building put-hedging flow (pc_oi_ratio 1.69, +27.5% over 5 sessions).
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and nothing here should be read as a signal to execute a position. SET50 options are cash-settled on the index with no physical delivery, so dealer-hedging pinning/wall dynamics are structurally weaker here than for physically-settled single-name equities; treat every wall, flip, and max-pain level as a tendency, not a guarantee, especially at 75 days-to-expiry where gamma concentration is still comparatively low.
